title: Photos taken every 2 minutes today vs. the entire 1800s

source.name: Global photo volume estimates
source.publisher: Photutorial / PetaPixel / Mylio annual photo-count compilations

notes: The world takes an estimated 61,400 photos per second in 2025 (about 7.4 million every 2 minutes). Estimates for total photographs taken across the entire 19th century (1800-1899) run from roughly 2 million to 10 million; this uses a compiled middle estimate of about 5 million, consistent with the widely cited claim that more photos are taken every couple of minutes today than existed in all of the 1800s.
